title: 第5章  相亲，然后造下一代！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
装甲一连，营区西侧的卫生间。
一个头戴白头盔，肩膀上佩戴者菱形纠察袖章的一期士官，小心翼翼地从卫生间门口挪了出来。
周磊脚步放得极轻，整个人弓着身子，眼神高度警惕，脑袋左右快速扫视，目光扫过墙角死角、走廊拐角，不放过任何一处可以藏人的位置，一举一动满是戒备。
连续观察确认四周空空荡荡，没有半个人影后，周磊紧绷了两天的神经终于松弛下来。
就在他暗自庆幸、稍稍放松的时候，一道低沉慢悠悠的声音，毫无预兆地从身后传了出来：“周磊，好久不见啊。”
周磊浑身汗毛瞬间炸立，大脑一片空白，一股深入骨髓的恐惧席卷全身。
根本来不及思考、来不及回头确认，他身体本能触发反应，当场大叫一声，脚下发力，拔腿就往前狂奔。
就在他刚冲出两三米远的时候，身后爆发出一阵大笑声。
“哈哈哈！站住！别跑了！”
“笑死我了，周磊你这反应也太快了！”
周磊只觉笑声格外的熟悉，当即转头看去。
树荫下，两个熟识的纠察兵的身影走了出来，正是同班组的老李和小杨。
两人笑得前仰后合，一手叉腰一手指着他，脸上满是戏谑，显然是躲在树后看热闹许久了。
看到两人，那深入骨髓的恐惧顿时褪去，但随之而来的是憋屈跟恼怒。
他快步折返回来，脸色铁青：“你们两个神经病啊！没事吓我干什么？”
老李收敛了些许笑意：“怪我们？谁让你现在跟得了PTSD一样，风声鹤唳草木皆兵，随口一句话就能把你吓破防，至于吗？”
一旁的小杨也跟着点头，憋着笑补了一句：“就是啊周哥，林毅都退伍走了，你这后遗症也太严重了，有点小题大做了吧。”
“至于？怎么不至于！”
周磊没好气地甩开两人的手，语气又气又无奈：“你们是没挨过他的毒打！前两次退伍，哪次不是白天好好道别，等不到晚上就偷偷摸过来堵我？狠狠地揍我一顿，然后告诉我他又回来了！”
“他妈的，我能不慌吗？换你们你们也害怕！”

连续两次的阴影，早就成了他军旅生涯最大的心理阴影。
哪怕所有人都说林毅走了，他依旧不敢彻底放心。
明明前两次就是，上午刚走，下午就回来！跟个鬼一样！
眼看着这第三次退伍，谁知道林毅会不会还来这一套！
他盯着小杨，语气郑重地追问：“我再问一遍，林毅是真的走了？大巴车真的开走了？没半路折返，没留后手？”
小杨用力点头，语气笃定：“真走了，百分百走了。”
“我上午就在营门执勤，亲眼看着他上的退伍大巴，亲眼看着大巴驶出营区、上了主干道，手续全部办完，档案交接完毕，不可能再回来了。”
得到这句确切的答复，周磊紧绷了两整天的神经，才算是彻底彻底放松下来。
他长长松了一大口气，浑身力气仿佛被抽空，后背早已被冷汗浸湿。
走了好啊，走了就好啊！
他起码不用担惊受怕了。
老李见状，拍了拍他的后背宽慰道：“行了行了，林毅这次是真走了，不可能回来了。”
周磊揉了揉发胀的太阳穴：“希望吧……这次可千万别再回来了。”
老李跟小杨看着他的样子，对视一眼，再也憋不住笑了，顿时发出一阵爽朗的笑声。
“喂，你们为什么还在笑！”
“我想起了好笑的事情。”
“什么？”
“我老婆今天生孩子。”
“卧槽？你他妈哪有老婆！别笑了！”
Y市，遇见咖啡厅。

林毅靠在靠窗的皮质座椅上，望向窗外的眼神里，满满的都是无奈。
他压根不想出现在这里，准确来说，他今天下午理应出现在烟城一中的门口，去办复读的手续。
选择去那复读，一来那是自己的母校，二来也是有些故人想去看看。
最主要的，还是当兵前的自己，在学校里可是留下不少传说。
也算是旧地重游了。
但自从他在家中撂下狠话，执意要重返部队、再次入伍之后，家里那两位大佬彻底动了真火。
老爷子冷脸沉默不语，他爸直接拍了桌子，死活不同意他再次折腾入伍。
为了彻底断了他回部队的念头，两人干脆加急操作，硬生生把原本定在明天的相亲，直接提前到了今天下午。
而且还说了，今天相亲成功，明天就见家长，顺便把婚期定下，后天两人就开始备孕，争取用最快的速度生下下一代。
然后林毅麻溜滚蛋，消失在两人面前，爱干嘛干嘛去。
一想到这个，他就觉得很无语，但细想一下，也倒是能理解。
毕竟他三次入伍，三次退伍，老爷子跟他爸早就成了部队的笑话了，而他也成了全国部队广为流传的一个特例。
他这要是四次入伍……呵呵，不用想都知道会发生什么。
但他必须要四次入伍，系统要求的激活条件，就是他踏入军营，穿上军装，重新入伍！
而且，他算是看出来了，爷爷跟老爸是铁了心想要让他结婚生孩子，所谓的给他自由根本不可能。
谁能保证他结婚生孩子之后，就能自由了？就没有别的要求了？
他还不如回部队呢，最起码还能图个清静。
而对于这场相亲局，他也早已盘算清楚了。
随便应付一下，对方但凡有点想法，他就主动摊牌拒了，和平散场，谁也不耽误谁。
只要相亲黄了，家里就没理由逼他成家，他也才有重新入伍的机会。

就在林毅思绪纷飞之际，咖啡厅的玻璃门被人轻轻推开。
一道高挑挺拔的身影缓步走入店内，立刻吸引住了店内不少人的目光。
女人身着简约得体的浅色连衣裙，长发乌黑柔顺，尽数挽在脑后，露出纤细白皙的脖颈，线条干净利落。
五官精致绝伦，眉眼清冷疏离，唇色偏淡，自带一股生人勿近的高傲气质，是标准的御姐长相。
一眼望去，惊艳夺目，妥妥的貌若天仙。
林毅下意识抬眼望去，目光微微一顿。
他在部队待了整整六年，日复一日见的都是糙老爷们、铁血战友。
老话讲“当兵三年，母猪赛貂蝉”，但他心智正常，眼光从未跑偏。
不是许久不见异性就自带滤镜，是眼前这个女人是真的实打实漂亮，气质身段、容貌风骨，无可挑剔，远超常人。
女人步伐不急不缓，款步走到林毅面前的桌前。
她垂眸看向落座的林毅，语气平淡清冷：“你是林毅？”
content_en:
Armored Company 1, bathroom on the west side of the camp.
A first-term non-commissioned officer wearing a white helmet and a diamond-shaped picket armband on his shoulders carefully moved out of the bathroom door.
Zhou Lei's steps were very light, his whole body was hunched, his eyes were highly alert, his head was quickly scanning left and right, his eyes were scanning the blind corners of the wall and the corners of the corridor, not missing any place where people could hide, and his every move was full of vigilance.
After continuous observation to confirm that the surrounding area was empty and there was not a single figure, Zhou Lei's nerves that had been tense for two days finally relaxed.
Just when he was secretly rejoicing and relaxing a little, a low and slow voice came from behind without warning: "Zhou Lei, long time no see."
The hair on Zhou Lei's body suddenly stood up, his mind went blank, and a bone-deep fear swept through his body.
There was no time to think or turn around to confirm. His body instinctively triggered a reaction. He screamed on the spot, exerted force under his feet, and ran forward wildly.
Just when he rushed two or three meters away, a burst of laughter broke out behind him.
"Hahaha! Stop! Don't run!"
"I'm laughing so hard, Zhou Lei, your reaction is too fast!"
Zhou Lei felt that the laughter was particularly familiar and immediately turned around to look.
Under the shade of the trees, two familiar picket figures came out. They were Lao Li and Xiao Yang from the same team.
The two of them were laughing so hard, with one hand on their hips and the other pointing at him. Their faces were full of banter, and they had obviously been hiding behind the tree to watch the fun for a long time.
Seeing the two of them, the fear that penetrated into the bone marrow immediately faded away, but what followed was frustration and anger.
He turned back quickly, his face ashen: "You two are crazy! Why did you scare me when nothing happened?"
Lao Li suppressed his smile a little: "Blame us? Who made you feel like you have PTSD now? The sound of wind, cranes, and grass and trees are all at war, and a casual word can scare you off your guard, right?"
Xiao Yang on the side also nodded, suppressing a smile and added: "That's right, Brother Zhou, Lin Yi has already retired from the army, and your sequelae are too serious. You must be making a fuss out of a molehill."
"As for it? Why not!"
Zhou Lei threw away the two men's hands angrily, and said in an angry and helpless tone: "You have never been beaten by him! The first two times you were discharged from the army, when did you not say goodbye properly during the day, and sneak up to block me before night? Beat me up, and then tell me that he is back!"
"Damn it, can I not panic? You would be scared too!"
The two consecutive shadows have long become the biggest psychological shadow in his military career.
Even though everyone said that Lin Yi was gone, he still didn't dare to feel completely relieved.
Obviously the first two times, I just left in the morning and came back in the afternoon! Like a ghost!
Seeing that he is discharged from the army for the third time, who knows if Lin Yi will do this again!
He stared at Xiao Yang and asked in a solemn tone: "Let me ask again, did Ji Yi really leave? The bus really left? Did he not turn back halfway, and did he leave no backup plan?"
Xiao Yang nodded vigorously and said firmly: "I'm really gone, 100% gone."
"I was on duty at the camp gate in the morning and watched him get on the retirement bus. I watched the bus drive out of the camp and onto the main road. All the procedures were completed and the files were handed over. It was impossible to come back."
After receiving this exact answer, Zhou Lei tensed his nerves for two whole days before he finally relaxed.
He let out a long breath of relief, all the strength in his body seemed to be drained away, and his back was already soaked with cold sweat.
It's good to go, it's good to go!
At least he didn't have to worry anymore.
Seeing this, Lao Li patted his back and said comfortingly: "Okay, okay, Lin Yi really left this time, and there is no way he will come back."
Zhou Lei rubbed his swollen temples: "I hope...don't come back this time."
Lao Li and Xiao Yang looked at him, looked at each other, couldn't hold back their laughter anymore, and burst into hearty laughter.
"Hey, why are you stillLaughing! "
“I remember something funny. "
"What? "
“My wife is having a baby today. "
"What the hell? You don't have a fucking wife! Stop laughing! "
City Y, meet the coffee shop.
Ji Yi leaned on the leather seat by the window, looking out the window with helplessness in his eyes.
He didn't want to appear here at all. To be precise, he should have appeared at the door of Yancheng No. 1 Middle School this afternoon to go through the procedures for repeating his studies.
I chose to go there to repeat my studies because, firstly, it was my alma mater, and secondly, I had some old friends who wanted to visit.
The most important thing is that he was himself before joining the army, and he left many legends in the school.
It’s like revisiting an old place.
But ever since he made harsh words at home and insisted on returning to the army and re-enlisting, the two big brothers in the family became really angry.
The old man remained silent with a cold face, and his father slapped the table directly, refusing to agree with him to enlist in the army again.
In order to completely put an end to his thoughts of returning to the army, the two of them rushed to work and moved the blind date originally scheduled for tomorrow to this afternoon.
And he also said that today they have a successful blind date, they will meet their parents tomorrow, and set a wedding date by the way. The two of them will start preparing for pregnancy the day after tomorrow, striving to give birth to the next generation as quickly as possible.
Then Lin Yi rolled away and disappeared in front of the two of them, doing whatever he wanted.
When he thought of this, he felt speechless, but if he thought about it carefully, he could understand it.
After all, he joined the army three times and was discharged three times. The old man and his father have long become a joke in the army, and he has become a special case widely circulated in the army across the country.
If he enlists in the army four times... Haha, you don't have to think about it to know what will happen.
But he must enlist in the army four times. The activation condition required by the system is for him to step into the military camp, put on military uniform, and re-enlist in the army!
Moreover, he finally saw that his grandfather and father were determined to get him married and have children, and it was impossible to give him freedom.
Who can guarantee that he will be free after getting married and having children? Don’t have any other requirements?
He might as well go back to the army, at least he could have some peace and quiet.
As for this blind date, he had already made a clear plan.
Deal with it casually, and whenever the other party has an idea, he will take the initiative to show his cards and reject it, and end the game peacefully without delaying anyone.
As long as the blind date turns out to be bad, his family will have no reason to force him to start a family, and he will have a chance to re-enlist in the army.
Just as Ji Yi's thoughts were swirling, the glass door of the coffee shop was gently pushed open.
A tall and straight figure slowly walked into the store, immediately attracting the attention of many people in the store.
The woman is wearing a simple and decent light-colored dress. Her long black and smooth hair is pulled back behind her head, revealing her slender white neck with clean and neat lines.
Her facial features are exquisite, her eyebrows are cold and distant, her lips are light-colored, and she has an arrogant temperament that keeps strangers away from her. She is the standard appearance of a royal sister.
At first glance, it is stunning and dazzling, and it looks like a fairy.
Ji Yi subconsciously raised his eyes and paused slightly.
He stayed in the army for six full years, and he saw rough men and comrades-in-arms day after day.
As the old saying goes, "After three years in the army, a sow competes with a Diao Chan." But he was in a normal mind and his vision never strayed.
It’s not that you put on your own filters when you haven’t seen someone of the opposite sex for a long time. It’s that the woman in front of you is really beautiful. Her temperament, figure, and appearance are impeccable and far beyond ordinary people.
The woman walked slowly and leisurely to the table in front of Ji Yi.
She lowered her eyes and looked at Ji Yi who was sitting down, and said in a calm and cold tone: "Are you Ji Yi? "
